With reference to the submission of Financial Results under Regulation 33 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, for the quarter ended 30.06.2026, we wish to inform you that the Standalone Financial Results are being re-submitted in the prescribed format for the purpose of record and compliance. 
We clarify that there is no change whatsoever in the financial figures as originally submitted. The present submission is being made only to ensure that the Standalone Financial  Results are available in the format prescribed under Regulation 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, along with LRR. 
We further clarify that the present re-submission is being made voluntarily for completeness of records and to ensure adherence to the prescribed regulatory format.
We request you to take the above submission on record.
